title: The Archive That Only Grows in Winter

features.name: ice-locked node
features.desc-on-touch: The casing sleeps under a lattice of frozen breath. Batteries count the quiet months slower than they count the warm.

features.name: frost memory
features.desc-on-touch: Crystals grew in the shape of transmissions — signals frozen mid-sending, preserved in ice lattice.

features.name: sealed record
features.desc-on-touch: The archive's winter log, locked behind condensation. What bloomed while everything was sleeping — dates when the nodes spoke to each other, nobody listening.

features.name: root-writing
features.desc-on-touch: Beneath the snow, something wrote itself downward. The letters are not words yet. They are learning.

features.name: temperature dial
features.desc-on-touch: The gauge reads nothing — the temperature has become too still to measure. Or the stillness itself is the measurement.

inscription: growth waits in silence for the season that asks no permission

file.name: Winter_Node_Installation_Night_257.txt
file.note: Katita's field notes from the alpine installation, dated in snow-months, dated in the quiet.

reverie.title: REVERIE — frozen installation at first light
narr: The tree holds the node like a secret. You feel the
casing's cold through your gloves, the antenna angling
skyward through the bark. She checks the battery log,
her breath becoming part of the signal. The forest is
asleep around you both. The mesh grows in silence.
In this cold, growth is only what the sensors remember.

exits.label: back toward the deep repository where all utterance waits
where ice teaches things to remember backwards
